questions.q: Which nutrient is the body’s main source of energy during exercise?
questions.why: Carbohydrate is the main fuel, stored as glycogen.

questions.q: Which mineral is needed to make haemoglobin?
questions.why: Iron is needed for haemoglobin, which carries oxygen.

questions.q: Which nutrient is mainly needed for growth and repair of muscle?
questions.why: Protein provides amino acids to build and repair muscle.

questions.q: Explain why drinking water is important during a long run in hot weather.
questions.model: Water replaces fluid lost through sweat, preventing dehydration. Dehydration thickens blood, raises heart rate and body temperature, and causes fatigue.
